notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Timestream Navigator to get +1/+0 and become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator that is a 1/1 Soldier creature.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
